Do you love to let your inner gypsy loose, and wear hand-dyed, colorful long skirts? Do you enjoy the look and feel of natural fibers like rayon? Our bohemian maxi skirt is made from 100% rayon fabric. Rayon is made from natural cellulose plant material and, like cotton, is breathable and absorbent. It is soft and lightweight, perfect for spinning and twirling skirts when you dance, and absorbs color dyes to get the most brilliant hues!
